candidate: H59 shared width-288 parallel residual MLP with layer-private coordinates

parent_evidence.causal_transition: H58 improves heldout covariance to 69.17%, but its JVP RMSE remains 0.748 because both value and tangent corrections are post-transforms of the step-zero output. Learn the residual function and its Jacobian directly from the residual input with an equal-budget parallel nonlinear atlas.

scientific_question: Can an equal-budget shared nonlinear residual MLP plus layer-private gains and thresholds reproduce all terminal MLP outputs and exact input JVPs without storing dense or empirical bases?

frozen_teacher.procedural_parent_policy: Use exact step-zero MLP tensors in the audit; exclude them from the compact artifact and require independent config-seed regeneration identity before any later model training.

initialization.initial_function: exact step-zero procedural MLP because residual write U is zero

fit.objective: mean relative output MSE plus 0.25 times relative exact input-JVP MSE
fit.layer_schedule: deterministic round-robin over all twelve layers

controls.step_zero_parent: set residual write U to zero
controls.global_coordinates: replace every layer's fitted gain/bias by their across-layer means
controls.initial_random_detector: replace fitted T by the exact initial T while retaining fitted U/gain/bias
controls.linear_residual: replace GELU by identity in the fitted residual branch
controls.dense_teacher: exact terminal teacher output and input-JVP identity

runtime_gates.watchdog_policy: terminal/error callbacks plus one resettable 90-minute heartbeat for any run observed or projected above five minutes

promotion: Only an every-layer representation pass authorizes exact-config latency and MFU measurement. Only representation plus performance may authorize one 124M CE acquisition. A pass does not authorize scale-up or attention work.
failure: Close this exact width-288 parallel residual MLP without width, activation, coordinate, seed, optimizer, horizon, CE, attention, or scale sweeps.
forbidden: stored PCA or empirical trajectory basis
persistent FP16 or FP32 dense endpoint master
changing residual width, activation, initialization, optimizer, objective or gates after seeing results
CE, attention work or scale-up before representation and performance gates pass
calling regenerated step-zero endpoints compact checkpoint state
